content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after a crypto payment is a streamlined solution for digital creators, especially in countries with limited access to payment platforms. This infrastructure allows creators to sell products like ebooks directly to consumers without incurring hefty fees from traditional platforms. By leveraging decentralized payment methods, creators maintain full control over their sales processes and retain a higher percentage of their earnings. This is especially crucial in regions where creators are often locked out of major platforms and face challenges like currency instability.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of this automated delivery system utilizes a combination of cloud-based technologies and cryptocurrency payment gateways. When a customer makes a purchase, the transaction is processed through NOWPayments, which verifies the payment on-chain. Once confirmed, an automated script—either via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script—triggers the delivery of the ebook to the customer. This seamless integration ensures instant fulfillment without manual intervention, enhancing the user experience while keeping operational costs low. The use of free hosting solutions such as Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages further minimizes expenses, allowing creators to focus on their content.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators operating in regions with restricted access to mainstream payment platforms. It specifically caters to those selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products that require reliable, low-cost payment processing. Creators in countries like Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and Venezuela can benefit significantly from this setup, as it allows them to bypass traditional financial barriers. By adopting this system, creators not only enhance their revenue potential but also gain the sovereignty they need to operate independently in a global marketplace.
Automated delivery means no manual fulfillment—save time and increase efficiency.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The automated ebook delivery system consists of several key components working in harmony. Firstly, NOWPayments facilitates the crypto payment process without requiring KYC verification, allowing customers to pay seamlessly in over 300 cryptocurrencies. Secondly, the hosting services—Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages—provide a reliable platform for product storage and delivery. The backend logic, executed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensures that the order fulfillment occurs automatically once payment is confirmed. This integrated approach not only ensures efficiency but also guarantees that creators maintain ownership of their data and digital assets.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your automated ebook delivery system, start by selecting your hosting platform, either Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, for free. Next, set up a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions securely. Utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to create the backend automation that triggers the ebook delivery. Load your products into a storage solution, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring easy access post-purchase. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to get your system up and running efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings with NOWPayments versus 90% with platforms like Gumroad.

If you're looking to expand your digital product offerings, consider exploring related searches on building a sovereign digital store. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) contains everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your commerce stack efficiently, all while avoiding platform fees. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook without PayPal or Stripe?
You can use NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency transactions, enabling you to sell ebooks directly without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Setting up your own storefront using hosting services like Cloudflare Pages and integrating NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads with minimal fees.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. By utilizing the infrastructure provided by COREMERCH, you can sell templates and fonts directly and retain more of your earnings.
What fees should I expect using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a nominal fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%.
Is my data secure with this setup?
Yes, you retain full ownership of your data and products, ensuring that your information is secure and not subject to the restrictions of third-party platforms.
Full ownership of your digital assets protects your business from platform changes.
